item.title: MLB rumors: Should Phillies add any of top remaining starting pitchers?
item.description: The Phillies haven't been tied directly to any of the remaining talented starting pitchers in free agency. But they have a need, and reports are going out of their way to include their team's name.

item.title: The Flyers left opportunity on the table, now they're paying for it
item.description: Details have been missing, way too many open shooters have been left unchecked, and crucial points have been given away. Now the Flyers face a steep climb that they easily could've spared themselves.

item.title: Eagles offensive coordinator search, coach rumor and report tracker
item.description: After trudging through the 2025 season with a bad, boring offense, the Philadelphia Eagles relieved offensive coordinator Kevin Patullo of his duties. We'll see if more firings of positional coaches are to follow. Here we'll keep track of all the hirings, firings, interviews, and noteworthy rumors in one place.

item.title: SEPTA to start using 10 leased cars next week to boost Regional Rail service
item.description: SEPTA released new schedules for Regional Rail lines that will go into effect next week and will utilize 10 train cars that were leased from Maryland’s public transit system.

item.title: Lottery for Independence Blue Cross Broad Street Run runs Feb. 1-13
item.description: The Independence Blue Cross Broad Street Run returns Sunday, May 3, bringing the city’s biggest road race back to Broad Street for its 47th year.

item.title: Estate of Bloomsburg University student who died after fraternity hazing event awarded $7.8 million
item.description: The estate of Justin King, a Bloomsburg University student who fell to his death following a fraternity rush event in 2019, was awarded $7.8 million by a jury in Luzerne County. King, who grew up in Montgomery County, fell down a 75-foot embankment after a night of heavy drinking.

item.title: Eagles hire Sean Mannion to be their offensive coordinator
item.description: Mannion played in the NFL for nine seasons from 2015 to 2023, initially with the Rams, and then three different stints each with the Vikings and Seahawks. He got right into coaching after his playing days were through, serving as a Packers offensive assistant for one year in 2024, before being promoted to quarterbacks coach in 2025.

item.title: Proposed ICE restrictions appear to have enough City Council support to become law without mayor's signature
item.description: A legislative package that would put new restrictions on federal immigration agents has the support of 15 City Council members — enough to become law without Philadelphia Mayor Cherelle Parker's signature, council members say.

item.title: Woman charged with pepper-spraying conservative influencer on SEPTA bus
item.description: Paulina Reyes, 22, faces multiple charges related to a Jan. 19 altercation in which she pepper-sprayed conservative influencer Frank Scales on a SEPTA bus in South Philadelphia, the Pennsylvania Attorney General's Office said.

item.title: Instant observations: Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid carry the load from start to finish as Sixers escape vs. Kings
item.description: All day Thursday, the Sixers' messaging was clear: they could not take a perceived easy matchup against Sacramento lightly. Tyrese Maxey and Joel Embiid certainly did not.
